items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc3hXIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--010292e1bb6d6bade7c9e99830ccb49a2079c9ad/image.png) **ATENÇÃO** Essa competição será realizada de uma forma diferente das demais, nela você terá que escolher um evento entre os seguintes para participar: 3x3 ou 2x2 4x4 ou OH Pyraminx ou Skewb 5x5 ou Square-1 Você não pode competir em dois destes eventos ao mesmo tempo, se você se inscrever em dois deles, levaremos em conta como se você tivesse escolhido aquele com menos participantes. Ou seja, se a Modalidade A tiver 10 inscritos e a B, 5, e você se inscrever nos dois, nós excluiremos a sua inscrição da Modalidade A. Você não precisa se inscrever em todas as modalidades. Se não desejar participar de nenhuma das duas que acontecerem em determinado momento, não precisa se inscrever em nenhuma. Caso deseje alterar seus eventos, deve contactar os Delegados ou Organização. Quaisquer outras dúvidas, favor contatar os delegados. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition will be run in a different way to the others, you will have to choose an event from the following to take part in: 3x3 or 2x2 4x4 or OH Pyraminx or Skewb 5x5 or Square-1 You can't compete in two of these events at the same time. If you sign up for two of them, we'll take it into account as if you'd chosen the one with fewer participants. In other words, if Event A has 10 entrants and Event B has 5, and you sign up for both, we will exclude your entry from Event A. You don't have to sign up for all Events. If you don't want to take part in either of the two taking place at any given time, you don't need to register for either. If you want to change your events, you must contact the Delegates or the Organization team. If you have any other questions, please contact the delegates **AOS NOVATOS:** Por favor, enviar um email para [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) ou trazer um documento com foto, data de nascimento e nome completo para fins de completação do processo de registro. **FOR NEWCOMERS:** Please send an email to [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) or bring an ID that contains a photo, date of birth and full name to complete the registration process. Inscrição de competidor: R$ 25,00 A entrada do público será livre. Limite de competidores: 40. **HAVERÁ PREMIAÇÕES EXTRAS: 3X3 FEMININO E 3X3 INICIANTES** **TAMBÉM TEREMOS AS CATEGORIAS JUVENIS, NAS QUAIS PREMIAREMOS O MELHOR DE CADA MODALIDADE COM MENOS DE 16 ANOS** Registration fee: R$ 25,00 Guest entry will be free Competitor limit: 40. **THERE WILL BE EXTRA AWARDS FOR: NEWCOMERS AND FEMALES** **THERE WILL BE THE JUVENILE CATEGORIES, IN WHICH IT WILL BE AWARDED THE BEST ON EACH EVENT WITH AN AGE UNDER 16 YEARS** REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 40 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com um dos Delegados através do e-mail. REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact one of the Delegates via email.

items.name: Please Be Solved This Time Joburg 2023
items.information: ## This is not a normal competition We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is entirely focused on blindfolded events,. If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province. **Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. ## Venue The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue. There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information in the comments of their registration: 1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number. 2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with. 3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this. Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address. ## Guests Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023

venue.details: Open floor area set up in a shopping mall

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens. ### Masters and Challengers This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes! ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ### Spectators As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited. ### Volunteering Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### Sponsorship Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners! ### Lucky Draw During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#34417-faq) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). **ATTENTION** Cette compétition n'est PAS une compétition classique. Il n'y aura qu'une seule épreuve : la résolution optimisée (Fewest Moves), pendant laquelle la solution la plus courte à un mélange donné doit être trouvée et écrite sur une feuille en un temps maximum d'une heure. **Il n'y aura pas de 3x3 classique lors de cette compétition.** ---- Please **read the registration conditions, the [FAQ](#34417-faq) et the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. **WARNING** This competition is NOT a regular competition. There will be only one event: Fewest Moves, in which the shortest solution to a given scramble must be found and written on a sheet of paper in a maximum of one hour. **There will be no 3x3 in this competition.**

items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 para os competidores, pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA; 3. Atentar-se ao cronograma da competição. Este ano, por conta da prova do ENEM no dia 12/11, optamos por colocar as modalidades mais tradicionais e normalmente com maior número de inscritos no primeiro dia de competição (11/11, sábado). Atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus respectivos cortes/limites; 4. Caso queira adquirir a camiseta do campeonato, entre em contato com o organizador através do email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. Para informações adicionais verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador via email (welbertmoutta@gmail.com). **ENGLISH** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules; 3. Pay attention to the competition schedule. This year, due to the ENEM test on 11/12, we chose to put the more traditional events and usually with the highest number of competitors on the first day of competition (11/11, Saturday) Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 4. If you want to purchase the championship t-shirt, contact the organizer via email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com).

venue.name: [大田区消費者生活センター](http://www.city.ota.tokyo.jp/shisetsu/seikatsu_center/index.html)

items.information: ### コンセプト スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。 昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。 この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 Tokyo Challenge VI 2023(**本大会 / 以下、VI大会**)、[Tokyo Challenge VII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVII2023) (**以下、VII大会**) 及び[Tokyo Challenge VIII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVIII2023)(**以下、VIII大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。 VII大会、VIII大会およびVI大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 **未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。** もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人) 見学者はメールよりお問い合わせをお願いいたします。 また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### Concept Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records. In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them. To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time. ### WCA Series Competitions WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can** only** participate in one of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid. Tokyo Challenge VI 2023 **(This Competition / hereinafter referred to as Competition VI**) ,[Tokyo Challenge VII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVII2023) (**Competition VII**) and [Tokyo Challenge VIII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVIII2023) **(Competition VIII**) are WCA series competitions. You can participate in only one of the VII, VIII, and VI competitions. ### Requirements for non-competitors **Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space. There are restrictions for guests and visitors** This competition does not have on the spot registration for competitors or visitors. **Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. We ask competitors over the age of 18 are to come without a guest.** If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor. (1,000 yen per visitor) Visitors please make your inquiry by email. Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.name: Warsaw Cube Masters 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png) #### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca! Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe. Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt". --- #### Warsaw Cube Masters returns! We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition. Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento! * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Pagamento da taxa via PIX: mauriciopmfernandes@gmail.com Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor. **Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). Para este campeonato, além dos próprios competidores, teremos um pequeno grupo de Staff para ajudar ao longo da competição. Payment with PIX method: mauriciopmfernandes@gmail.com Send the payment proof to E-mail: gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org Send the proof with the competitor's name. **Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). For this competition, besides the competitors themselves we will have a small group of dedicated Staff to help throughout the day. items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.** **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0pMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bcff7b5bdf0f0846e919c48b2fc43d8a54c9d36f/UKC%202023%20LOGO%20-%20RGB%20(FOR%20SCREENS)%20-%20(TRANSPARENT)%20-%20(WITH%20SPONSORSHIP).png)

Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat) y de la AES [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2hMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--14c85d7c918289412994eb77f529bb474910e16e/image.png) Το Salonica Autumn Open '23 είναι o τελευταίος διαγωνισμός αυτής της σειράς για το 2023 στο δρόμο για τα πρώτα Greek Nationals! Είμαστε πλέον πολύ περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Αυτή τη φορά επισκεπτόμαστε τη βόρεια Ελλάδα και την αγαπημένη μας συμπρωτεύουσα τη Θεσσαλονίκη! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Salonica Autumn Open 2023 is the last competition of the Road to the first Greek Nationals series of this year! We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KubeKidsVilaVelha2023/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! items.information: V-Cubes is proud to bring back cubing competitions to Spiel Messe in Essen! **Note:** V-Cube Spiel B 2023 is a series competition to V-Cube Spiel A 2023 on the same weekend. Please note that you may only register for one of the two competitions. V-Cubes ist stolz darauf, wieder Speedcubing-Turniere auf der SPIEL Messe in Essen präsentieren zu dürfen! **Wichtig:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 ist eine Partner-Competition von V-Cube Spiel B 2023, die am gleichen Wochenende stattfindet. Bitte beachte, dass du dich nur für eines der beiden Turniere anmelden darfst. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbDRkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ef25795363481ab9b918d882fa96ca2c55097150/v-cube.png) To participate in this competition, you must have a ticket for Sunday at the Essen Spiel Messe exposition. This ticket needs to be bought individually and is not included in the registration fee. The competition will take place at Hall 5, Booth 5A108. You can see the site plan of Messe Essen [here](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf). If you are a new competitor, take a look at the corresponding tab. All competitors should be familiar with the information in the tab. items.name: CubingZA Cape Cubes Spring 2023

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, having multiple rounds of everything, as well as having some attempts of 4BLD and 5BLD in the morning. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). For 4x4 and 5x5 Blindfolded, which will be in the early morning on both days, we ask for competitors to please reach out to us before the competition to volunteer to be judges during these events. By doing so and helping out, you will earn yourself a free cup of coffee/tea/hot chocolate! ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: BMME 3x3 Day 2023
items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BMME 3x3 Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und du deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes. Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich hauptsächlich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the BMME 3x3 Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan and delegated by Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room). If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning). It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we mostly have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nesta competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Prestar atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 3. Preencher o seguinte [formulário](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7w5hqTt8BB-GbKildtIHah7ygjYonOWLStzRI10ndMDp8gA/viewform) para facilitar o controle dos nomes dos competidores e acompanhantes por parte da equipe do Planetário envolvida com a organização; 4. Para obterem a entrada e permanência na competição, os **acompanhantes** deverão adquirir os ingressos na bilheteria do Planetário. Cada competidor terá direito a 1 (um) ingresso no valor de meia entrada (R$10) para um acompanhante. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20). **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes** e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$30 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7w5hqTt8BB-GbKildtIHah7ygjYonOWLStzRI10ndMDp8gA/viewform) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **guests** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium ticket booth. Each competitor will be entitled to 1 (one) ticket worth half price (R$10) for a single guest. The other guests, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20). **This fee is applied only to guests only** and must be paid only on the days of the competition, and must not be made via the PIX transfer for payment of registration; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate (isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type " favoris ", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées et les inscriptions comportant plus de quatre (4) épreuves ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Loutraki Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVpJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b69d3e8ec74c2e903cc944222c628b961b4e6ae/357003767_748136693777038_1928584195019389868_n.jpg) To Loutraki Open 2023 είναι ο 4ος διαγωνισμός WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 16 και 17 Σεπτεμβρίου 2023 στην Κορινθία που είναι η γενέτειρα του Παναγιώτη Βερδέ, ιδρυτή και εφευρέτη των Ελληνικών κύβων [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) , που έχουν φτάσει σε 116 χώρες. Οι Ελληνικοί κύβοι [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) ήταν αυτοί που από το 2008 επέκτειναν την σειρά των κύβων από το 5χ5. Το Loutraki Open 2023 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα του WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , όπου ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste). Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στο [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) στο Λουτράκι για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be) Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Loutraki Open 2023 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες. Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στις 31.07.2023 και κλείνουν στις 11.09.2023. Loutraki Open is the 4th WCA Competition in Greece during 2023. The competition is taking place on the 16th and 17th September 2023 at Korinthia prefecture which is the place of birth of Panagiotis Verdes, who is the founder and inventor of the Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) that have reached 116 countries. The Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) were the ones that since 2008 they have extended the cube line with cubes of more than 5 layers. Loutraki Open 2023 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , that they all belong to [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste) . Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come to [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) at Loutraki for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing! Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information. Notice of Acceptance for Filming or Photography Competitors and other Attendees of Loutraki Open consent to their images being used by the organizers and its partners in marketing and promotional actions and materials, social media and other digital platforms. Online registration open 31.07.2023 and close 11.09.2023.

items.name: NCR Please Be Quiet 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Please be quiet Most of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), or the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît La plupart des épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch NÖ Cube Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Das Turnier findet im Veranstaltungszentrum Z2000 statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the NÖ Cube Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh and is delegated by Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ(以下 TSC)は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」を定期的に開催しており、2023年9月に100回目の開催を迎えます。これを記念し、第100回TSCスペース記念大会を開催します。 今大会は受付時間を設けておりません。参加される競技に合わせてお越しください。競技の進行によっては時間を前倒しで進めますので余裕をもってお越しください。 今大会終了後に第100回TSCスペースを開催します。詳細は[第100回TSCスペース記念サイト](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/)をご覧ください。 Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as TSC) has been holding off-line meetings for speedcubers called "TSC Space" on a regular basis and will celebrate its 100th meeting in September 2023. Please come according to the competition you will be participating in. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be ahead of schedule, so please ensure to arrive in plenty of time. items.name: Get to Work Chicagoland 2023
items.information: Competitions in highly populated areas - like this one - tend to fill quickly, and do have limited spots. Please [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/register) as soon as you are able, in order to secure a spot in this competition. If you are on the [competitor list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/registrations) and are no longer planning on competing in this competition, please cancel your registration. There will be competitors on the [waitist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28080-waitlist) who are wishing to take your place, and you wil recieve a refund if you cancel by the refund deadline. Please review the "[Competitor Responsibilities/Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28078-competitor-responsibilities-info-must-read)" tab, and other tabs as necessary, before the competition. Please take note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change depending on whether this competition is running ahead of time, or behind on time. We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events. At the end of the competition, please pick up any garbage left over and dispose it. This will allow the opportunity that we can use this venue again for more competitions in the future. Tendrán la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades, aprender de los mejores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de un día inolvidable rodeados de personas apasionadas como ustedes. In this third edition, we meet once again at the prestigious Teatro Montealegre to celebrate our shared passion for this challenging color puzzle. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your skills, learn from the best and, above all, enjoy an unforgettable day surrounded by passionate people like you. Whether it's your first time participating in a championship or you're already a veteran solving Rubik's cubes, everyone is welcome!

We are running three competitions as part of Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) and [evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023)! venue.name: Spin Master Toronto
venue.address: 225 King St W #200, Toronto, ON M5V 3M2

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBakE3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fef34846d3c62170fea8a28a2f5b052616366ff3/Rubik-poster-1080x1080p-Final.jpg) ## Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) is excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at Spin Master's HQ in the heart of downtown Toronto, Canada! ## Qualification To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-9.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before August 1, 2023. If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Greater Toronto Area—including Ajax 3x3x3 [Morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [Afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) or [Evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023), taking place the day after All-Stars. We also invite you to watch Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 via the livestream! ## Spectators and Livestream We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details. Competitors are permitted to bring two guests. Unfortunately, due to limited space in the competition venue, other in-person spectators are **not** permitted at Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: # Español ¡Bienvenidos al Nayar Open 2023, el **primer torneo oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días 19 y 20 de agosto de 2023. ¡Prepárate para vivir una experiencia única y desafiar tus habilidades en la resolución del cubo Rubik. El Nayar Open 2023 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Este es el primer torneo organizado por el [Team Nayarit](https://www.facebook.com/rubik.nayarit/). Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. # English Welcome to the Nayar Open 2023, the **first official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of Tepic on August 19th and 20th, 2023. Get ready to have a unique experience and challenge your skills in solving the cube. The Nayar Open 2023 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their dexterity and compete in a variety of modalities and categories. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This is the first tournament organized by [Team Nayarit](https://www.facebook.com/rubik.nayarit/). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: Tauranga Open 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: **This competition will take place inside of the Denver Zoo. The price of your registration will cover the cost of admission to the zoo, as well as lunch at one of the restaurants inside the zoo. You MUST read the tab about tickets and lunch before registering to ensure that you are able to get into the zoo.** This competition is managed financially by Colorado Cubers, a non-profit association. We understand that the registration fees for this competition are higher than usual, but please recognize that everyone working these competitions is a volunteer and our organization will be taking a considerable loss as a result of this event. We hope to be able to put on a unique experience that will be enjoyable for everyone. All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition. **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. Competitors can also perform some modifications to their registration through the Register tab. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, no refund will be offered due to the budget for this competition but we will give your spot to a different cuber eager to compete! The deadline to cancel your registration is July 14th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. The deadline to edit your registration is July 28th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. items.name: 24 Hours in Flen 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Flen! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **koncept**. Notera också att en sängplats (vandrarhemsstandard) över natten samt frukost ingår i anmälningsavgiften, i samma hus som tävlingen genomförs i. -- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Flen! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the **concept** tab. Also note that a hostel style bed and breakfast is included in the registration fee, in the same house as the competition will take place in.

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Capixaba Challenge 2023 é o 15º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register); - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) do Rafael Cinoto; - Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição; - Divirta-se! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Capixaba Challenge 2023 is the 15th Official Competition of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register) tab; - Arrive at the competition venue 30 minutes before the event in which you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) by Rafael Cinoto; - Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition; - Have a lot of fun! ------------------------------------- ### Organização/Organization: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1k4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--05c34cfd81e1c48df3d1c4c00f5fa2977da05bc5/logo-speedcubes%20(1).png)

Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 54 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 54 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg) Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! During each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). items.name: Pickering Side Events 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Pickering Side Events 2023 Cubing on the Canada Day long weekend! As we celebrate our country and communities, Canada Day is also an important opportunity to reflect on the historical and ongoing colonization and erasure of Indigenous Peoples on the lands we now call Canada. This competition will be held on the Treaty and traditional territory of the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation and Williams Treaties signatories of the Mississauga and Chippewa Nations. All proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Indian Residential School Survivors Society](https://www.irsss.ca) and [Woodland Cultural Centre](https://woodlandculturalcentre.ca). ## Side Events This competition has "side events", which does _not_ include the standard 3x3x3 Cube event. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&show_registration_status=on) if this competition is not suitable for you. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
